description: Search verified x402 sellers by capability (from Agenstry, Open 402, pay.sh, the Official MCP Registry, apis.io and other public registries; each with price, networks and evidence of a live 402 or manifest). Free tier returns the top 5; full results are the paid /search endpoint (x402 or MPP) on this host. Calls and paying wallets are P0's own on-chain transfer counts, null where not measured. Not for picking one service for a concrete task (use best_service_for_task), for market-wide totals (use x402_market_stats) or for this host's own products (use list_paid_data_products).

include_testnets.description: also list services that exist only on test networks (default false)

query.description: capability to look for, e.g. 'web search', 'llm inference'

name: search_x402_services
title: Search x402 services
